name: SVC_SR_SUMMARIZATIONS
description: This table stores various high-level metrics related to service requests. Each row captures a snapshot of the overall state of service requests at a specific point in time and remains unchanged once created.

columns.name: SR_SUMMARIZATION_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the stripe code, such as CRM, HCM, or PRM.

columns.name: SUMMARIZATION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which summarization data gets captured.

columns.name: SR_CREATED
columns.description: Count of all SRs created on the specific date.

columns.name: SR_CRITICAL_CREATED
columns.description: Count of Critical SRs created on the specific date.

columns.name: SR_OPEN
columns.description: Count of all SRs opened on the specific date.

columns.name: SR_OPEN_CRITICAL
columns.description: Count of Critical SRs opened on the specific date.

columns.name: SR_REOPEN
columns.description: Count of all SRs re-opened on the date.

columns.name: SR_REOPEN_CRITICAL
columns.description: Count of Critical SRs re-opened on the date.

columns.name: SR_INITIAL_QUEUE_ASSIGN
columns.description: Count of all SRs assigned to a queue for the first time on the date.

columns.name: SR_INITIAL_AGENT_ASSIGN
columns.description: Count of all SRs assigned to a named resource for the first time.

columns.name: SR_QUEUE_REASSIGN
columns.description: Count of all SRs re-assigned to a different queue on the date.

columns.name: SR_AGENT_REASSIGN
columns.description: Count of all SRs re-assigned to a different agent on the date.

columns.name: SR_UPDATED
columns.description: Count of all SRs that saw some update activity on the date.

columns.name: SR_RESOLVED
columns.description: Count of all SRs resolved on the date.

columns.name: SR_CLOSED
columns.description: Count of all SRs closed on the date.

columns.name: SR_DELETED
columns.description: Count of all SRs deleted (soft) on the date.

columns.name: SR_PURGED
columns.description: Count of all SRs permanently deleted on the date.

columns.name: SR_ALL_OPEN
columns.description: Count of all open SRs (irrespective of creation date) as on the date.

columns.name: SR_ALL_OPEN_CRITICAL
columns.description: Count of all open and critical SRs (irrespective of creation date) as on the date.

columns.name: SR_ALL_REOPEN_CRITICAL
columns.description: Count of all SRs that are critical and re-opened (any date) and still open on that date.

columns.name: SR_ALL_REOPEN
columns.description: Count of all SRs that were re-opened (any date) and still open on that date.

columns.name: SR_ALL_NEW
columns.description: Count of all SRs in new status type.

columns.name: SR_ALL_INPROGRESS
columns.description: Count of all SRs in In Progress status type.

columns.name: SR_ALL_WAITING
columns.description: Count of all SRs in Waiting status type.

columns.name: SR_ALL_UNASSIGNED
columns.description: Count of all SRs not assigned to a specific agent yet (including in queues).

columns.name: SR_ALL_UNCLAIM
columns.description: Count of all SRs across Count of all queues that have not been claimed yet.

columns.name: SR_ALL_AWAITING_CUSTOMER
columns.description: Count of all SRs awaiting customer response.

columns.name: SR_ALL_PENDING_AGENT
columns.description: Count of all SRs pending agent action.

columns.name: SR_ALL_UNRESOLVED
columns.description: Count of all unresolved SRs.

columns.name: SR_ALL_RESOLVED
columns.description: Count of all resolved SRs but not yet closed.

columns.name: SR_ALL_CLOSED
columns.description: Count of all closed SRs.

columns.name: SR_ALL_DELETED
columns.description: Count of all SRs that are deleted (soft).

columns.name: SR_ALL_PURGED
columns.description: Count of all SRs permanently deleted.
